stream_dependency_structure.blas: hipblasSetStream to same executor stream; observed small-batch nodes use project kernels
stream_dependency_structure.runtime_internal_queues: not exposed by graph introspection; no inference about hidden driver scheduling
stream_dependency_structure.natural_completion: Executor::Wait: SignalDone on same stream after suffix and stop event; hipStreamQuery submission hint, coherent host-flag poll; 1-second fallback existing hipStreamSynchronize not reached in these rounds

experiments.A: FAIL: 233/504 measured suffix elapsed values negative after successful same-stream record/launch/record and natural completion; all record/query/elapsed/launch codes 0; no NotReady. Prefix durations positive but positivity alone does not validate them.
experiments.B: Inclusive natural batch intervals positive with all success statuses; warmup 3-row 8 suffixes 583.325 ms; measured 3-row 2 suffixes 241.486 / 187.775 ms, measured 2-row 2 suffixes 121.010 / 106.429 ms. Shape changes end batches before new suffix. Intervening prefix/MTP/rollback/host waits included, plus next-shape prefix on break; wall ends at safe consumption and may additionally include next suffix. No pure consecutive graph-only batch naturally exists in this generation path. NOT validated pure graph GPU time; do not divide these values into per-suffix GPU costs.
experiments.C: SKIPPED (conditional): hipGraphClone and event record APIs are available, but a graph clone retains live recurrent/KV/rollback/scratch/host output buffer pointers. No isolated state/buffer replay harness exists. Launching it would mutate production state or require copying/rebinding an unbounded model state beyond this narrow diagnostic. Never substituted/modified a live graph.
experiments.variations: Only standard events and the A/B patterns; C feasibility assessed; no flag sweep, explicit synchronization, external profiler, or extra generation requests.

failure_classification.correlation: Negative values recur on large mixed-copy suffixes across all three graph generations and broad reuse counts. Short prefix is also kernel+copy linear DAG but no D2H. Synthetic is one kernel on nonblocking stream with final event synchronization. Long graph size, H2D/D2D/D2H nodes, stream flag and completion mechanism differ; none was independently varied, so none is proven causal.
failure_classification.raw_timestamp_limit: hipEventQuery/ElapsedTime expose status and elapsed only; no supported raw per-event timestamp accessor in installed public headers. No driver internals accessed.

performance.causal_overhead: not isolated: no contemporaneous OFF pair within the 1+2 request cap; under-2% overhead not established. Diagnostics restored.

resources.leak_scope: No growth observed over 3 requests; bounded fixed event pools and four topology dumps; engine stopped and trial removed. Not a long-run leak proof.

builds: production-build.log: JSON unsigned conversion compile failure
production-build-final.log: PASS via scripts/build.ps1 -SkipBundledTests; cached/offline dependencies; no suite
recommended_prompt14_scope: Prompt 14: one gated, correctness-preserving A/B confined to Executor::GatedExperts -> qfn_mmq_moe_gated_vec -> launch_moe_grouped -> mul_mat_vec_moe_grouped for 2/3-row Q4_K verification. Inspect the split multi-request/single-request dispatch (false/true variants) at tokens >= 3. The suffix has 46 Q4_K layers with the extra dispatch (47 including prefix); this is a structural candidate, not a measured GPU bottleneck. Preserve expert masks, slot ownership, quantization, reduction order and arithmetic. Judge one candidate by dependency-bound full verification-round wall time and end-to-end decode against an OFF control, with exact hashes/speculation counts. Do not remove either pass merely because it is an extra launch: they process disjoint active-expert cases. No MTP, sampling, PLE, shortlist, D2H, wait, or graph-boundary changes.
